Are you passionate about using data to drive business decisions at massive scale? EU Vendor Intelligence is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to help power Amazon's growth and profitability across European markets.

In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. You will partner closely with Program Managers and Vendor Managers — not just answering their questions, but refining problems, recommending alternatives, and anticipating future analytical needs. You will own mid-to-large BI solutions end-to-end: from data modelling and pipeline design to dashboards and deep-dive analyses that drive real business decisions.

What you'll do:
• Design robust, maintainable data models and pipelines that power reporting and analytics for EU-wide retail programs
• Write advanced SQL and leverage scripting (e.g. Python) to solve difficult analytical problems and automate BI processes
• Build compelling visualizations and self-service reporting that reduce bottlenecks and put data directly into stakeholders' hands
• Develop a deep understanding of data lineage — from source systems through metrics aggregation to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PMs, VMs, Data Engineers, other BIEs) to deliver solutions that balance business needs with technology constraints
• Improve code quality, optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability, and mentor teammates

This is a high-visibility role where your analytical rigor and business acumen will directly influence how Amazon grows selection and manages vendor relationships across Europe. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions — and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions — data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of data lineage: source systems, metrics aggregation logic, and how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon by stakeholders
• Partner with Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and cross-functional teams to refine business requirements, recommend analytical approaches, and anticipate future needs
• Build self-service reporting and visualization solutions that reduce bottlenecks and empower business partners to access data independently
• Ensure all solutions are efficient, testable, maintainable, well-documented, and resistant to data quality issues
• Optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability; establish data and reporting SLAs where appropriate
• Mentor junior team members and contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a data pipeline you built, checking for anomalies before a weekly business review. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with a Vendor Manager, refining requirements for a new selection coverage analysis. After lunch, you're writing SQL to model vendor performance data, then building a QuickSight dashboard that lets Program Managers self-serve insights without waiting on ad-hoc requests. Later, you review a teammate's code, suggest a cleaner data model, and wrap up by automating a manual reporting step that's been slowing the team down.

About the team
The EU Vendor Intelligence Team builds BI solutions and capabilities that empower business users to self-serve their analytics and data needs across EU Stores. We support a wide variety of programs — from selection growth and vendor management to vendor education and vendor-facing chatbot tools. Our mission is to make data accessible, reliable, and actionable so that Program Managers and Vendor Managers can make faster, better-informed decisions at scale. We value automation over manual work, clean data models over quick fixes, and strong partnerships with the business teams we serve.

회사 소개

CLS(Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다.

CLS는 국토교통부로부터 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다.

로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

Logistics Supply Chain Innovation (LSCI) 팀은 Coupang의 Fulfillment Network 전반을 대상으로 물류 운영 프로세스, 네트워크 구조, 시스템 로직 및 운영 모델을 데이터 기반으로 분석하고 개선하는 조직입니다.
FC(PICO, MFC)와 DC의 발주부터 입고까지 전 과정을 분석하여 운영 비효율을 제거하고, 생산성 향상, 비용 최적화, 재고 운영 개선을 위한 혁신 과제를 발굴하고 실행합니다. 또한 Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance 등 다양한 Cross-functional 파트너와 협업하며 복잡한 공급망 문제를 해결하고 최적의 의사결정을 지원합니다.
이를 통해 Coupang의 물류 경쟁력을 강화하고, 고객에게 더욱 빠르고 안정적인 로켓배송 경험을 제공하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 수행합니다.

업무 내용

• 물류센터 물량 확보를 위한 수요 분석 및 발주 전략 수립
• 입고 운영 효율성 향상을 위한 프로세스 개선 및 자동화 기획
• 재고 운영 데이터 분석을 통한 관리 지표 개발 및 운영 인사이트 도출
• 데이터 기반의 대시보드 및 운영 관리 도구 개발·고도화
• 물류 성장과 적정 재고 유지를 위한 발주 프로세스 개선 및 품질 관리

자격 요건

• 5년 이상의 데이터 기반의 운영 프로세스 기획 및 자동화 경험을 보유하신 분
• SQL, Microsoft Excel, Python(Pandas) 등을 활용한 데이터 추출 및 관리 경험을 보유하신 분
• 데이터 선정, 분석을 통한 의사결정과, 이를 기반으로 효과적인 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

우대 사항

• 물류 또는 이커머스 분야에서 발주 및 물류센터 입고 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
• 변화가 많은 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 신속하게 업무를 추진한 경험을 보유하신 분
• Apache Airflow를 활용한 데이터 전처리 및 파이프라인 구축 경험을 보유하신 분
• 최적화 모델링 또는 시뮬레이션 기반의 의사결정 및 문제 해결 경험을 보유하신 분
• 성장 및 혁신 목표 달성을 위한 전략 수립과 실행 경험을 보유하신 분
• 마감 기한에 맞춰 주도적으로 업무를 수행하고 결과를 도출한 경험을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형절차

• 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will oversee mechanical contractors and crews building the advanced mechanical infrastructure for SpaceXAI's Data Centers — including large-scale HVAC and cooling systems, chilled water plants, condenser water systems, process piping, pumps, CRAC/CRAH units, cooling towers, and fire protection systems. If you thrive on hands-on leadership, complex industrial mechanical construction, and contributing to high-impact AI infrastructure, join us to help deliver one of the most advanced and efficient data centers in the world.

This is a full-time, onsite role based in Memphis, Tennessee, with relocation required depending on additional construction locations within the US.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Oversee and coordinate mechanical installations including chilled water piping, condenser systems, HVAC equipment, cooling towers, pumps, heat exchangers, ductwork, CRAC/CRAH units, and fire suppression systems for SpaceXAI Data Centers.
• Manage and schedule mechanical contractors, subcontractors, and on-site crews to deliver project milestones on time and to SpaceXAI's exacting quality and reliability standards.
• Ensure all contractors adhere to mechanical scope, delivering high-integrity cooling and process systems critical to data center uptime, efficiency, and thermal management.
• Monitor daily progress of mechanical construction, maintaining detailed logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for all mechanical infrastructure.
• Develop and enforce aggressive construction schedules while keeping the project on time and within budget.
• Champion and enforce SpaceXAI's safety program, building a zero-incident culture across all teams working around heavy mechanical equipment, pressurized systems, and elevated work.
• Supervise foremen and mechanical crews, fostering teamwork and accountability in a high-stakes mission-critical environment.
• Proactively resolve on-site challenges — material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing issues, and coordination with electrical/civil trades — with a strong focus on mechanical system reliability and code compliance.
• Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with local regulations, mechanical codes, safety protocols, and SpaceXAI's stringent quality standards.
• Prepare and present clear progress reports, mechanical construction metrics, and risk updates to senior leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years managing mechanical construction teams with strong emphasis on large-scale industrial or mission-critical mechanical projects.
• 3+ years of direct hands-on experience in mechanical installations including process piping, HVAC systems, chilled water plants, pumps, and cooling infrastructure — ideally on data centers, industrial processes, or heavy mechanical projects.
• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Postsecondary diploma or degree in construction management, mechanical engineering, or related field.
• Proven track record supervising mechanical construction for data centers, hyperscale facilities, or similar mission-critical environments.
• Familiarity with Memphis-area building codes, mechanical regulations (IMC, ASME, NFPA), and industrial permitting.
• Experience with construction management software (Procore, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, MS Project, etc.) on complex infrastructure projects.
• Deep knowledge of mechanical construction critical paths, sequencing, and coordination with electrical/civil trades through commissioning and startup.
• Strong understanding of data center mechanical specifications, redundancy requirements (N+1, 2N), energy efficiency, and cooling systems designed for 24/7 operation.
• Demonstrated ability to lead diverse crews under tight deadlines while maintaining collaboration and safety.
• Expert-level commitment to mechanical safety (pressure systems, LOTO, confined space) and history of building strong safety cultures on regulated sites.
• Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills for technically complex mechanical scenarios.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Project) for reporting and scheduling.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to relocate within the US depending on construction location(s)
• Subject to pre-employment drug screening and random drug and alcohol testing.
• Subject to pre-employment and annual post-employment background checks.
• Comfortable working in industrial environments with exposure to noise, heavy equipment, excavations, and mechanical systems.
• Available for evenings and weekends as site operational needs dictate.
• Ability to lift 25+ lbs and perform physically demanding tasks in outdoor/tight conditions.

If you are a hands-on mechanical construction leader who excels in high-stakes, mission-critical environments and is ready to drive the delivery of groundbreaking AI infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.
